name: agent-orch
description: Multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code with 26 specialized agents including the Advocate (architecture challenge & governance), Jira Triage agent, Private Cloud agent, 8 lightweight commands, wave execution, /make feature lifecycle with worktree-or-branch choice (/make, /make-validate, /make-clean preserves release/* branches) and parallel-safe per-Claude session state files (.claude/.make-session-<UTC_TS>-<PID>.json) with a guard-worktree-writes PreToolUse hook that hard-blocks agent writes drifting into the primary checkout during a worktree session, date-tree session artifacts (ssnc-agent-orch/YYYY/MM/DD/<feature>/), /brainstorm skill (Socratic design-before-code with a hard pre-implementation gate; writes a DESIGN.md that /build consumes), /bugfix skill (focused root-cause fix wrapping the systematic debugger; regression-test-first, worktree-aware, 3-attempts-then-escalate), /make-bug skill (bug-fix lifecycle wrapping /bugfix on a worktree or feature branch: commit, push, and open a PR; reuses /make session state so /make-validate and /make-clean work unchanged), /create-rfo (postmortem -> RFO doc + PDF; optional --wiki <path> files the synthesis into a team-work wiki and archives the transcript under sources/incidents/), /release-me (tagged release with notes + PDF + GitHub release), /jira-work skill (Jira-driven work queue with human-on-the-loop governance), /init-plugin and /upgrade-plugin lifecycle wizards, /simplify skill, /refactor-to-bluestone skill (Bluestone design system enforcement), /loop-library skill (find, save, audit, repair, adapt, or design bounded repeatable agent loops with explicit verification and stopping conditions, backed by a local git-committed catalog in .loop-library/ with no network calls; worktree/branch-aware like /build and /bugfix so catalog writes stay anchored to the active session and never leak into the primary checkout, and on save it offers current-session / new-worktree / new-branch, landing the new ones through commit + push + PR; methodology adapted from Forward Future's Loop Library, MIT), confidence scoring, role personas, compound learning, native Agent Teams integration, two-stage code review with reviewer anti-gaming rules, a shared verification-before-completion policy, verification gates, enforcement rules, CLAUDE.md protection, systematic debugging, plugin inheritance, /github-issues skill (GitHub Issues backend on code.ssnc.dev via the gh CLI — a drop-in alternative to /jira selected per-repo with a tracker: switch; same human-on-the-loop label governance), a backend-neutral tracker-provider contract (tracker-provider.md) so /make, /build, /make-clean and the work queue talk to Jira OR GitHub Issues unchanged, opt-in extensibility framework (config files under .claude/ssnc-agent-orch/ with before/replace/after agent hooks, skill hook points, pluggable issue tracker + Jira + GitHub + git workflows; zero behaviour change by default), and a local MCP server for Jira, Confluence, TestRail, Azure DevOps, Playwright, SonarQube, SS&C Cloud, and ServiceNow (read-only).
